summary_1line: Pulastya continues describing numerous sacred tirthas and their rituals, promising great spiritual merit, purification of sins, and heavenly rewards for devoted pilgrims.

image_candidates.scene_text: Pilgrims bathe at the confluence of the Ganga and Yamuna while priests offer oblations as the sacred rivers meet under a glowing sky.
At the source of the Ganges in the Himalayas, a lone pilgrim bows before the icy stream emerging from the mountain like a gate to heaven.
In the forest shrine of Sakamvari, ascetic rishis gather as the goddess, living on herbs, offers them simple plants beneath ancient trees.
